title: APRV with a release that lasts too long: derecruitment every breath
summary: ARDS on APRV 28/0 with a fixed 1.2 s release. Alveolar pressure never falls back to Plow before the next Phigh, so auto-PEEP builds release after release and the schematic SpO2 slides; watch the truth layer's recruited-volume readout too, for a more severely collapsible lung this same too-long a release derecruits with every cycle. Ending the release at 75 % of the peak expiratory flow, instead of a fixed time, stops it before it runs on past the point of doing more good.
objectives: Read the auto-PEEP badge and the recruited-volume readout on the truth layer while the release runs long.
Fix by terminating the release on flow (75 % of PEFR) so the end-release pressure stays above closing.

fix.note: Flow-terminated release (TCAV, 75 % of PEFR) with a 1.0 s cap: the release ends before the dependent lung closes.
